subtopics.label: Single-Cell Multi-Omics and Transcriptomics
subtopics.description: Research employing single-cell RNA sequencing, multi-omics profiling (chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, transcriptome), and spatial transcriptomics to characterize cell-type-specific gene expression, epigenetic states, and splicing patterns across tissues and disease contexts.
subtopics.short_description: Cell-type-specific gene expression, epigenetic states, and splicing patterns via single-cell and spatial transcriptomics.

subtopics.label: Metabolomics and Metabolic Profiling
subtopics.description: Studies applying untargeted and targeted metabolomics, metabolic flux analysis, and metabolic pathway characterization to identify biomarkers, disease subtypes, and metabolic reprogramming in cancer, diabetes, neurodegeneration, and other conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Untargeted and targeted metabolomics to identify biomarkers, disease subtypes, and metabolic reprogramming across conditions.

subtopics.label: Epigenomics, Chromatin Architecture, and Gene Regulation
subtopics.description: Research investigating DNA methylation, histone modifications, chromatin accessibility, 3D genome organization, and enhancer-promoter interactions to understand transcriptional regulation, cell identity, and disease-associated epigenetic alterations.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation, histone modifications, and 3D genome organization underlying transcriptional regulation and disease.

subtopics.label: Proteomics, Protein Interaction Networks, and Biomarker Discovery
subtopics.description: Studies using mass spectrometry-based proteomics, proximity labeling, protein-protein interaction mapping, and quantitative proteomic profiling to characterize protein networks, identify biomarkers, and understand disease mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: Mass spectrometry-based proteomics and interaction mapping to characterize protein networks and discover biomarkers.

subtopics.label: Transcriptomic Analysis of Disease Mechanisms and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research applying bulk RNA sequencing, transcriptomic profiling, and gene expression analysis to characterize disease-associated transcriptional signatures, identify biomarkers, and elucidate molecular mechanisms in cancer, infection, and organ pathology.
subtopics.short_description: Bulk RNA sequencing and gene expression profiling to identify disease-associated transcriptional signatures and mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics, Tumor Evolution, and Clonal Dynamics
subtopics.description: Research integrating whole-genome sequencing, structural variant analysis, clonal lineage tracing, and multi-omics to characterize tumor heterogeneity, mutational signatures, cancer evolution, and mechanisms of metastasis and therapy resistance.
subtopics.short_description: Whole-genome sequencing and multi-omics characterization of tumor heterogeneity, mutational signatures, and therapy resistance.

subtopics.label: Multi-Omics Data Integration and Computational Methods
subtopics.description: Development and application of computational frameworks, machine learning models, Bayesian methods, network embedding, and statistical tools for integrating multi-omics datasets, identifying disease subtypes, and enabling biomedical discovery.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning, Bayesian, and network-based frameworks for integrating multi-omics datasets and enabling biomedical discovery.

subtopics.label: Brain Connectivity, Network Neuroscience, and Neurological Disease
subtopics.description: Research applying functional and structural connectome analysis, network control theory, and computational modeling to characterize brain state dynamics, predict cognitive outcomes, and understand neurological and psychiatric disorders.
subtopics.short_description: Connectome analysis and computational modeling of brain state dynamics, cognitive outcomes, and neurological disorders.

subtopics.label: Space Biology and Astronaut Multi-Omics
subtopics.description: Multi-omics studies characterizing molecular, physiological, and immunological changes in astronauts during and after spaceflight, including transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, epigenomics, and microbiome profiling.
subtopics.short_description: Multi-omics characterization of molecular, physiological, and immunological changes in astronauts during spaceflight.

subtopics.label: Microbiome-Host Interactions and Metabolic Signaling
subtopics.description: Research integrating metagenomic, metabolomic, and transcriptomic approaches to characterize how gut and environmental microbiomes influence host metabolism, immunity, bile acid signaling, and disease susceptibility.
subtopics.short_description: Metagenomic and metabolomic approaches linking gut microbiome composition to host metabolism, immunity, and disease.

subtopics.label: Gene Regulatory Networks and Transcription Factor Biology
subtopics.description: Studies elucidating transcription factor networks, enhancer activity, gene regulatory circuits, and chromatin remodeling complexes that control cell fate decisions, differentiation, and disease-associated transcriptional programs.
subtopics.short_description: Transcription factor circuits, enhancer activity, and chromatin remodeling controlling cell fate and disease-associated programs.

subtopics.label: Drug Repurposing, Knowledge Graphs, and Precision Medicine
subtopics.description: Research developing and applying biomedical knowledge graphs, network pharmacology, and machine learning to identify drug repurposing opportunities, predict therapeutic targets, and enable precision oncology and disease treatment.
subtopics.short_description: Network pharmacology and machine learning applied to knowledge graphs for identifying therapeutic targets and repurposing candidates.

subtopics.label: Cell Cycle Regulation, Proliferation, and Quiescence
subtopics.description: Research investigating molecular mechanisms controlling cell cycle entry, CDK activity, quiescence, and proliferation commitment, including signaling dynamics, feedback loops, and their dysregulation in cancer.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of cell cycle entry, CDK activity, quiescence, and their dysregulation in cancer.

subtopics.label: RNA Modifications, Splicing, and Post-Transcriptional Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing m6A and other RNA modifications, alternative splicing, polyadenylation, and isoform diversity using long-read sequencing and computational tools to understand post-transcriptional gene regulation in development and disease.
subtopics.short_description: m6A modifications, alternative splicing, and isoform diversity shaping gene regulation in development and disease.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming in Cancer and Therapeutic Targeting
subtopics.description: Research characterizing metabolic pathway alterations in cancer cells—including lipid metabolism, mitochondrial function, NAD/NADP biosynthesis, and amino acid metabolism—and identifying metabolic vulnerabilities for therapeutic intervention.
subtopics.short_description: Lipid, mitochondrial, and amino acid pathway alterations in cancer cells and their exploitation for therapeutic intervention.

subtopics.label: Lymphoma and Leukemia Genomics and Therapeutic Targeting
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular mechanisms, genomic drivers, and therapeutic vulnerabilities in B-cell lymphomas, T-cell lymphomas, and acute leukemias, including studies of oncogenic mutations, tumor microenvironment, and targeted therapies.
subtopics.short_description: Genomic drivers, oncogenic mutations, and therapeutic vulnerabilities in B-cell lymphomas, T-cell lymphomas, and acute leukemias.

subtopics.label: Tumor Immune Microenvironment and Immunotherapy Response
subtopics.description: Studies examining immune cell composition, immune evasion mechanisms, and immunotherapy response within the tumor microenvironment across multiple cancer types, including checkpoint blockade, CAR-T cells, and tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte dynamics.
subtopics.short_description: Immune cell composition, evasion mechanisms, and checkpoint or CAR-T immunotherapy response across cancer types.

subtopics.label: Multi-Omics of Neurodegenerative Disease and Neuroinflammation
subtopics.description: Omics-based investigations of Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, tauopathies, and related neurodegeneration, including studies of microglial activation, tau propagation, protein aggregation, and metabolic dysfunction in the brain.
subtopics.short_description: Multi-omics investigation of Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and tauopathies including microglial activation and protein aggregation.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Host Molecular Response and Organoid Models
subtopics.description: Multi-omic and organoid-based studies of SARS-CoV-2 infection mechanisms, host immune and inflammatory responses, and COVID-19 disease progression including lung pathology, cardiac involvement, and long-term sequelae.
subtopics.short_description: Multi-omic and organoid-based studies of SARS-CoV-2 infection, immune response, and long-term disease sequelae.

subtopics.label: Mycobacterium tuberculosis Metabolism, Stress Response, and Drug Targets
subtopics.description: Studies of metabolic pathways, stress adaptation, and genetic essentiality in Mycobacterium tuberculosis and related mycobacteria, including nitrogen metabolism, lipid utilization, redox biology, and identification of novel drug targets.
subtopics.short_description: Metabolic pathways, stress adaptation, and genetic essentiality in Mycobacterium tuberculosis for novel drug target identification.

subtopics.label: Prostate Cancer Molecular Subtypes and Androgen Signaling
subtopics.description: Molecular characterization of prostate cancer progression, androgen receptor signaling, chromatin remodeling, and therapeutic resistance, including studies of tumor subtypes, metastasis, and neuroendocrine differentiation.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular characterization of prostate cancer progression, androgen receptor signaling, and therapeutic resistance mechanisms.

subtopics.label: Brain Organoids and Neuropsychiatric Disease Modeling
subtopics.description: Use of patient-derived cerebral organoids and 3D neural models to study neurodevelopmental and neuropsychiatric conditions including schizophrenia, autism, and substance exposure, revealing cell-type-specific molecular alterations.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-derived cerebral organoids revealing cell-type-specific alterations in schizophrenia, autism, and neurodevelopmental disorders.

subtopics.label: Adipose Biology, Obesity, and Metabolic Dysfunction
subtopics.description: Molecular and omics studies of adipocyte differentiation, adipose tissue remodeling, and obesity-related metabolic dysfunction, including lipid metabolism, mitochondrial function, circadian regulation, and inflammatory signaling in fat tissue.
subtopics.short_description: Omics studies of adipocyte differentiation, lipid metabolism, and inflammatory signaling underlying obesity and metabolic disease.

subtopics.label: Hematopoiesis, Clonal Evolution, and Epigenetic Regulation
subtopics.description: Studies of normal and malignant hematopoiesis focusing on epigenetic regulation, DNA methylation, clonal hematopoiesis mutations, and differentiation trajectories in blood cell lineages.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic regulation and clonal hematopoiesis mutations governing blood cell differentiation and malignant transformation.

subtopics.label: Endothelial Cell Biology, Vascular Remodeling, and Angiogenesis
subtopics.description: Research on endothelial cell heterogeneity, vascular development, angiogenesis, and vascular dysfunction in disease contexts including cancer, atherosclerosis, and organ development.
subtopics.short_description: Endothelial cell heterogeneity, angiogenesis, and vascular dysfunction in cancer, atherosclerosis, and organ development.

subtopics.label: Kidney Transplantation and Allograft Omics
subtopics.description: Transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic studies of kidney allograft function, rejection mechanisms, and biomarker discovery in transplant recipients, including urinary and blood-based molecular profiling.
subtopics.short_description: Transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic profiling of allograft function, rejection mechanisms, and transplant biomarkers.

subtopics.label: Network Analysis and Computational Omics Methods
subtopics.description: Development and application of computational methods for network analysis, community detection, multi-omics integration, and biomedical data science, including graph-based approaches, clustering algorithms, and statistical frameworks for omics data.
subtopics.short_description: Graph-based algorithms, community detection, and statistical frameworks for network analysis and multi-omics data integration.

subtopics.label: Pancreatic Beta Cell Biology and Diabetes Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Molecular studies of pancreatic beta cell function, failure, and regeneration in diabetes, including insulin secretion regulation, beta cell transdifferentiation, and therapeutic strategies to restore glucose homeostasis.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of beta cell function, failure, and regeneration underlying diabetes and glucose homeostasis.

subtopics.label: Airway Epithelium Transcriptomics and Lung Disease
subtopics.description: Transcriptomic and molecular studies of airway and lung epithelial responses to smoking, environmental exposures, and disease, including gene expression changes in COPD, lung cancer, and respiratory infections.
subtopics.short_description: Gene expression changes in airway and lung epithelium in response to smoking, environmental exposures, COPD, and infection.

subtopics.label: Epigenetic Aging, DNA Methylation Clocks, and Age-Related Biology
subtopics.description: Studies using DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks and age-related molecular signatures to quantify biological aging, identify age-modulating factors, and understand the molecular basis of aging across tissues and disease contexts.
subtopics.short_description: DNA methylation-based clocks and molecular signatures quantifying biological aging and age-modulating factors across tissues.
